sources.title: Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct-GGUF · Models
sources.snippet: This model is based on the T2ITrainer training framework, trained with approximately 7000 pairs of data for 2 epochs. It aims to repair images that have been damaged due to JPEG compression, resizing, and downloading, resulting in low-resolution and cyber-encrusted poor-quality images.
